notes:
Overview: Crestfall Product Labs builds a mid-market product analytics and insights platform. Moving from competitor LLM provider to Redwood for cost/perf and better control. Interested in hosted first to validate parity; plan to migrate to Dedicated (VPC) for steady-state traffic and data residency.

Key contacts:
- Emily Santos (Head of ML Platforms) – primary technical decision-maker, asked for prompt-parity tests.
- Mark Yao (VP Product) – business sponsor, care about latency and cost per active user.
- Alex Rivera (AE) – owner.

Recent activity (timeline):
- 2026-02-12: Intro call (AE + SE) — product overview, high-level requirements. Emily asked: "Can you match our prompt outputs exactly?" noted concern re hallucinations.
- 2026-02-18: Demo of Redwood Hosted API (Priya) — streamed chat demo w/ live prompts, EMR use-case. Fireflies ff-20260215-crestfall-demo-1 attached.
- 2026-02-25: Security screening kickoff — customer sent standard infosec questionnaire (SaaS vendor).
- 2026-03-03: POC kickoff — baseline tests set up against their current provider (traffic replay + synthetic prompts). Jira RED-7342 created for latency regression investigation.
- 2026-03-05: Deep-dive call on migration path (hosted -> dedicated). Discussed compatibility layer for API differences, token accounting, and function-calling parity. FF call ff-20260305-crestfall-aws-constraints.
- 2026-03-10: Mid-POC sync — initial embedding throughput looks OK; two prompt families show >5% semantic drift vs baseline (see POC notes). RED-7489 raised for prompt tuning pipeline.

POC scope and acceptance criteria:
- Parity: output parity for 80% prompts in intent classification and answer extraction tests.
- Latency: 95th percentile < 200ms for short chat queries under steady state (10 qps).
- Cost: demonstrate per-1M-token cost savings or comparable cost with better SLOs for peak bursts.
- Security: pass SOC2 evidence + SSO/SAML integration test in staging.

Technical notes / constraints:
- Current provider uses a proprietary chat wrapper; Crestfall relies on a small custom context preprocessor + function-calling shim. Need Redwood compat guidance for function-calling and streaming.
- Data residency: primary US, but legal requires audit logging of prompt/response for 12 months. KMS integration mandatory for Dedicated.
- Embedding usage: vector DB updates on every user event (high throughput, many small embedding calls). Need batching/async patterns.

Customer quotes and color:
- Emily on call: "We want output parity — not identical tokens, but same intent/score. Anything that changes user-facing labeling is a hard no"
- Mark: "If you can shave 30% off token cost at our scale we'll move fast. But security is non-negotiable."

Negotiation / commercial path:
- Starting with hosted POC under trial credits; expected to convert to a 12–18 month Dedicated commit if POC passes. Pricing conversations ongoing — need a Dedicated pricing sketch to present to finance.
- Internal procurement expects a vendor comparison by 2026-04-20.

Open items / blockers:
- Finish security questionnaire (Emily legal team) — outstanding items on data segregation and retention. Link: /drive/pricing/crestfall_dedicated_calc_v1.xlsx.
- Prompt parity regressions: engineering to run pairwise prompt diff and create tuning plan. Assigned to Priya.
- Dedicated sizing: need Redwood sizing recommendation for conservative steady-state 15 qps embedding bursts (ask infra team for GPU pool map).

Next steps (short):
- 2026-03-15: Deliver hosted POC perf report + example tuned prompt set.
- 2026-03-22: Security freeze call with Emily/legal to walk SOC2 artifacts and KMS approach. (owner: Alex)
